Reference image establishes exact swordsman identity, clothing and hand-painted style. CRITICAL camera correction: classic 3/4 top-down RPG projection, viewing from only about 30 degrees above horizontal. Directly SOUTH facing (toward screen bottom), both shoulders parallel to image plane. Show his face clearly as well as a modest top plane of hair. He holds his head upright looking ahead, NOT bowing his head, NOT steep bird's-eye view. No three-quarter left or right yaw. Compact stylized adult about FOUR HEADS tall, legs long enough for clear knee bending, boots moderate size. Preserve warm matte painterly 2D shapes, soften small texture detail for coherent animation, no pixelation, no 3D polygon look.

Sword held low at screen-right side, tip diagonally down-right, fully visible and separated from leg. Empty left glove loosely closed. No shield. 
Composition: ONE full body on a LARGE individual portrait 1024x1536 or higher canvas. Crown near y=170, chin near y=420, belt near y=850, boot soles near y=1380; torso center x=490; generous sword margin. These proportions are guidance for consistent subsequent animation, not labels to render. Keep full character and sword within canvas. Genuine transparent RGBA background, opaque character, no haze, no cast shadow, no floor, no words. This will be the identity and neutral pose for every subsequent frame.
